title: Photoluminescent exit signs: illumination, charging light and emergency power
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 6, 2025, last updated March 6, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the required illumination of photoluminescent (PL) exit signs under Articles 3.4.5.1 and 9.9.11.3.
An external lighting source is required to properly charge photoluminescent signs, and they must be lit in conformance with the charging requirements on the sign.
The interpretation states that the charging light source provided for PL exit signs does not require connection to the emergency power supply.
